title: FamilyTree
description: A family tree export file containing the family name, a list of persons, and a list of partnerships between persons.

name.description: Human-readable name of this family dataset. Used as the display label in the family selector.

persons.description: List of all persons in the family tree. Each entry represents one individual.

partnerships.description: List of partnerships (marriages, civil unions, or informal partnerships) between persons. Optional — omit or supply an empty array when there are no partnerships to record.

Person.title: Person
Person.description: A single individual in the family tree.

id.description: Unique identifier for this person within the dataset. Referenced by parent entries and partnerships.

name.description: Full display name of the person. May include maiden names in parentheses.

birthDate.description: Date of birth in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit or use an empty string if unknown.

deathDate.description: Date of death in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit or use an empty string if the person is still living or the date is unknown.

description.description: Free-text biographical notes about the person.
examples: Patriarch of the Harrison family. Worked as a carpenter for 40 years.
Adopted son of Robert and Linda. Joined the family at age 3.

image.description: Photo of the person. Must be either an HTTPS/HTTP URL or a base64-encoded data URI for PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, or SVG. Supply an empty string when no photo is available.

parents.description: List of parent references for this person. An empty array means no parents are recorded.

places.description: List of notable places associated with this person (birth, death, residence, work, etc.). Coordinates are added automatically when geocoding is performed.

Place.title: Place
Place.description: A notable place associated with a person, such as a birthplace, residence, or workplace.

type.description: Category of the place. `birth` — birthplace; `death` — place of death; `lived` — place of residence; `work` — workplace; `other` — any other notable place.

name.description: Human-readable name of the place, used for display and geocoding.

description.description: Optional free-text note about the person's connection to this place.
examples: Worked as a carpenter here for 20 years.

Coordinates.title: Coordinates
Coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates (WGS 84) for a place. Populated automatically by the geocoding step.

ParentRef.title: ParentRef
ParentRef.description: A reference from a child to one of their parents, together with the nature of that relationship.

personId.description: The `id` of the parent person in the same `persons` array.

type.description: Nature of the parental relationship. Use `adopted` for adoptive parents regardless of gender.

Partnership.title: Partnership
Partnership.description: A romantic or legal partnership between two persons in the family tree.

id.description: Unique identifier for this partnership within the dataset.

person1Id.description: The `id` of the first partner. Order is arbitrary.

person2Id.description: The `id` of the second partner. Must differ from `person1Id`.

type.description: Nature of the partnership. `marriage` — legally married (may have ended); `divorced` — marriage that ended in divorce; `partner` — unmarried/cohabiting partnership.

startDate.description: Date the partnership began (wedding date, move-in date, etc.) in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit if unknown.

endDate.description: Date the partnership ended (divorce, death, separation) in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit if the partnership is ongoing.
